title: EGamersWorld's listing and its own match page disagree, and most low-tier pages print a 1.8/1.8 placeholder
detail: A person (not the runner) read EGamersWorld's CS2 listing and match pages on 2026-10-22 between 07:55Z and 08:10Z for five fixtures that currently carry only a research-model pick. Four of the five print an identical 1.8/1.8 pair, which the site also uses as its default banner; the reviewed reference capture already rejects identical prices as a placeholder. For Nemesis-WW the listing printed 1.17/4.40 while the match page printed 1.8/1.8 and carried no bookmaker-average sentence. A third-party page that disagrees with itself cannot produce a reviewed price, so no listing number was promoted to a probability. The dated record, with both URLs and the quoted text, is data/research/ee27e097/egamersworld-observation.json.

title: EGamersWorld refuses the automated runner in plain HTTP and in a real Chromium context, so its captures stay manual and time-limited
detail: The read-only sweep from the GitHub runner on 2026-10-22T07:32Z returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' interstitial for the EGamersWorld CS2 listing and a match page, and a headless Chromium context (desktop user agent, UTC timezone) received the same security-verification page. The site's only reviewed use is the dated, hash-checked aggregated-bookmaker capture, which is accepted for eight hours; therefore a capture cannot keep a fixture priced across a later refresh, and every model-only row must stay labelled as a research estimate. This is an access limitation, not evidence that no market exists.

title: bo3.gg relayed a Thunderpick pair for a fixture that the published snapshot still prices with a Valve model
detail: On the same 2026-10-22T07:32Z observation the bo3.gg public API returned 100 upcoming fixtures, 23 with a named bookmaker quote block. One of them is 6yuBoJlbl vs ex-6666 (fixture 1081146, 19:00Z): Thunderpick 1.72 / 2.00, which the ladder's relay rung ranks above every research model. The published 05:36Z snapshot still shows a Valve-rating estimate for that fixture, because the relay only sees what bo3.gg has at fetch time. The next live refresh should promote it; this session verifies that the deployed snapshot does, and if it does not, the relay rung is the place to look.

title: No new automated two-sided price source closed the low-tier gap: HLTV 403, Oddspedia 410, BetExplorer 404, OddsPortal 503
detail: The brief asks to try HLTV first, then esportsbooks and betting lines, for the fixtures the featured method cannot resolve. The runner's dated sweep answered: HLTV match listing HTTP 403 (Cloudflare), Oddspedia CS2 HTTP 410 (permanently deleted), BetExplorer CS2 HTTP 404, OddsPortal CS2 HTTP 503. bo3.gg (200) and the Hotspawn lobby (200) answered; Hotspawn is inventory only and bo3.gg only relays prices for the subset of fixtures its bookmaker partner covers. The sweep is published under the unresolved register and on the new unresolved/ page, so the limitation is visible rather than implied.
